title: Detraining Effects Following Chronic Stretching Training on Range of Motion: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: Controlled trials and randomized controlled trials with a training and a detraining phase that involved any type of stretching training, with healthy participants of all ages, were included.
adjudication.k_quote: As eight randomized controlled trials and five controlled trials were included in the meta study
adjudication.reason: RVE meta-analysis pools 8 RCTs with 5 non-randomised controlled trials; no RCT-only pooled synthesis reported.
